The Japan Cup in November. That was where 
Fuji Kiseki would make her comeback.

"Living and running are so much fun!"—The 
passion Marvelous Sunday sowed brought 
Fuji Kiseki back to the stage.

With Air Groove, Fuji Kiseki, and now 
Marvelous Sunday joining in, this race is 
bound to be a top-class show.

To spread the Marvelous bigger and wider 
on this grand stage— The Japan Cup begins 
now!
